name: archive_probe
description: Say what an archive or a document shows about its own protection, and what it does not. ZIP: structural, from the End Of Central Directory record (empty and self-extracting archives included): per-member encryption, the WinZip AES extra field, DOS times with their raw words and no zone. 7-Zip: listed through the installed 7z (bounded, no password prompt) where there is one, giving the members, each one's encrypted flag and whether the header is encrypted; the start header is read and its checksums checked, and a byte search is kept as a hint only when 7z is absent or cannot read the file. RAR: identified, protection not determined. PDF and OLE/Office: a heuristic byte search for markers, reported with offsets, never as 'not encrypted' and never as a verdict (the structural document reader is not provided by this pack). Whether member names are readable is a finding separate from whether the data is encrypted. Nothing is extracted; metadata read is bounded by max_metadata_bytes and a result that was not listed says so.

path.description: A ZIP, 7-Zip, RAR, PDF or OLE document

limit.description: Members (or 7-Zip header strings) shown inline (default 200); all of them are counted, and when there are more the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in all_results

max_metadata_bytes.description: The most container metadata to load or search: a ZIP central directory, a 7-Zip header (default 33554432, at least 4096). A ZIP whose central directory is larger is not listed and says so
